summary_md: **TrustMount ([@TrustMountAI](https://x.com/TrustMountAI/status/2115797194691301625))** threads on **memory poisoning** as a persistent attack surface: a 20 Oct paper planted instructions in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini memory that persisted into new sessions ([arXiv 2610.28810](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28810)); OWASP lists it as ASI06 ([OWASP Agentic Top 10](https://genai.owasp.org/resource/owasp-top-10-for-agentic-applications-for-2026/)), and AgentPoison achieved over 80% attack success at under 0.1% poison rate ([arXiv 2407.12784](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.12784)). It recommends four controls (privileged writes, provenance, isolation with expiry, logging with rollback) and a test procedure, citing [Microsoft](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/catalog-ai-attack-techniques/ai-memory-context-poisoning) and the [OWASP cheat sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/AI_Agent_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html).
